title: Reefer Cargo Services: excursion credit request window and credits per service
content:
## Scope

This time and limit rule of **Reefer Cargo Services** sets by when an excursion credit must be requested, on which services a credit can be booked, and how many excursion credits one service can take.

## Rule

1. An excursion credit must be requested **no later than** the tier's report window after the reefer was delivered.
2. The window ends on the **delivery date** plus the tier's window days, counted on calendar dates. A request on the last day of the window is in time.
3. A credit may be booked only on a service that is **delivered or closed**.
4. A service takes at most the tier's maximum number of excursion credits, counted by the excursion credits already booked on that service.
5. The delivery date and the credits already booked are read from the company's records for that service.

## Tier table

| Tier | Report window after delivery | Excursion credits per service |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 0 calendar days | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 14 calendar days | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 21 calendar days | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 21 calendar days | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 30 calendar days | 2 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 21 calendar days | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical delivery on 3 March)

| Tier | Last day of the window | Request dated | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 17 March | 17 March | Yes: the last day is inside the window |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 17 March | 18 March | No |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 24 March | 24 March | Yes |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 2 April | 2 April | Yes |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 2 April | 3 April | No |

## Status and count check

| Situation | Can a credit be booked? |
|---|---|
| Service in transit, excursion already recorded | Not yet: the service is neither delivered nor closed |
| Service delivered, inside the window, no credit yet (AHL Reefer Monitored) | This rule does not stand in the way |
| Service closed, inside the window | Status permits it: closed is one of the two permitted states |
| AHL Reefer Monitored service already carrying 1 excursion credit | No: the maximum of 1 is reached |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP service carrying 1 excursion credit | A second credit stays within the maximum of 2 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP service carrying 2 excursion credits | No: the maximum of 2 is reached |
| AHL Reefer Standard service | No: the tier allows 0 excursion credits per service |

## Basis Q&A

**The customer reports the excursion while the container is still at sea.** A credit can be booked only once the service is delivered or closed; the window is counted from the delivery date.

**The service file has already been closed. Is it too late?** Not because of the closure; the test is whether the request falls on or before the last day of the window.

**Wrong reading:** "The window runs from the date of the excursion." **Correct basis:** it runs from the delivery date.
